name: brunette-playful-tongue-bedroom-selfie
image_purpose: Casual social-media selfie and home-life post

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical close-up UGC bedroom selfie for an approved adult, preserving the light-brown hair, oversized white sweatshirt, playful tongue-out expression, and natural daylight.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight light-brown hair, brown eyes, fair natural skin texture, soft natural makeup and defined eyelashes, wearing an oversized white sweatshirt and making a playful tongue-out expression toward the camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up selfie with head slightly tilted, face filling most of the frame, slightly low-to-eye-level 26mm front-camera angle. Include a simple bedroom with softly out-of-focus wall decor. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft side window light, warm natural skin tones, realistic highlights, subtle smartphone grain, casual daytime home atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone front-camera selfie, 26mm equivalent, vertical 9:16, sharp face, shallow natural background softness, authentic handheld framing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 close-up smartphone selfie of an approved adult woman with long straight light-brown hair, brown eyes, fair natural skin texture, soft natural makeup and defined eyelashes, wearing an oversized white sweatshirt and playfully sticking her tongue out toward the camera. Head slightly tilted, face filling most of the frame, simple bedroom with softly out-of-focus wall decor, soft side window light, warm natural skin tones, realistic highlights, minimal smartphone grain, candid playful mood.
